data.one_liner: Cross‑platform logger with simple API for console output and optional colorization.
data.what_it_does: Provides global logging functions (e.g., l.s, l.e, l.v) that write to the console on all supported platforms. It can capture prints, customize output, and expose a broadcast stream of log events.
use_when: You need quick, zero‑boilerplate logging across mobile, web, and desktop.
You want colored console output and the ability to listen to log streams.
avoid_when: You require structured logging with JSON output to external services without additional setup.
You need log persistence to files or databases out of the box.
strengths: Supports colorized output and custom formatting
Works on all major Flutter platforms
Provides a broadcast stream for reactive handling
weaknesses: No built‑in file or remote logging support
Customization requires writing your own handlers

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, feature‑rich logger with file output and hierarchical logging levels.
